001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007@HistoryLogProps(
008    opCode = 66,
009    displayName = "Bolus Requested 3/3",
010    internalName = "LID_BOLUS_REQUESTED_MSG3",
011    usedByAndroid = true,
012    usedByTidepool = true
013)
014public class BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
015    
016    private int bolusId;
017    private int spare;
018    private boolean queued;
019    private float foodBolusSize;
020    private float correctionBolusSize;
021    private float totalBolusSize;
022    
023    public BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog() {}
024    
025    public BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int spare, float foodBolusSize, float correctionBolusSize, float totalBolusSize) {
026        this(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, spare, foodBolusSize, correctionBolusSize, totalBolusSize, 0);
027    }
028
029    public BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int spare, float foodBolusSize, float correctionBolusSize, float totalBolusSize, int headerHighNibble) {
030        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, spare, foodBolusSize, correctionBolusSize, totalBolusSize, headerHighNibble);
031        this.pumpTimeSec = pumpTimeSec;
032        this.sequenceNum = sequenceNum;
033        this.bolusId = bolusId;
034        this.spare = spare;
035        this.foodBolusSize = foodBolusSize;
036        this.correctionBolusSize = correctionBolusSize;
037        this.totalBolusSize = totalBolusSize;
038    }
039
040    public BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog(int bolusId, int spare, float foodBolusSize, float correctionBolusSize, float totalBolusSize) {
041        this(0, 0, bolusId, spare, foodBolusSize, correctionBolusSize, totalBolusSize);
042    }
043
044    public int typeId() {
045        return 66;
046    }
047
048    /**
049     * <table border="1">
050     * <caption>Parsed fields for BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog:</caption>
051     * <tr><td><code>bolusId</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
052     * <tr><td><code>spare</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readShort(raw, 12)</code></td></tr>
053     * <tr><td><code>queued</code></td><td><code>raw[12] != 0</code></td></tr>
054     * <tr><td><code>foodBolusSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
055     * <tr><td><code>correctionBolusSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
056     * <tr><td><code>totalBolusSize</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
057     * </table>
058     */
059    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
060        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
061        this.cargo = raw;
062        parseBase(raw);
063        this.bolusId = Bytes.readShort(raw, 10);
064        this.spare = Bytes.readShort(raw, 12);
065        this.queued = raw[12] != 0;
066        this.foodBolusSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 14);
067        this.correctionBolusSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 18);
068        this.totalBolusSize = Bytes.readFloat(raw, 22);
069        
070    }
071
072    
073    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int spare, float foodBolusSize, float correctionBolusSize, float totalBolusSize) {
074        return buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, bolusId, spare, foodBolusSize, correctionBolusSize, totalBolusSize, 0);
075    }
076
077    /**
078     * <table border="1">
079     * <caption>Byte layout for BolusRequestedMsg3HistoryLog.buildCargo(...):</caption>
080     * <tr><th>Offset</th><th>Description</th></tr>
081     * <tr><td>0</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
082     * <tr><td>1</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
083     * <tr><td>2</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
084     * <tr><td>3</td><td><code>toUint32(pumpTimeSec) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
085     * <tr><td>4</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
086     * <tr><td>5</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
087     * <tr><td>6</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
088     * <tr><td>7</td><td><code>toUint32(sequenceNum) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
089     * <tr><td>8</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
090     * <tr><td>9</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
091     * <tr><td>10</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
092     * <tr><td>11</td><td><code>firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
093     * <tr><td>12</td><td><code>toFloat(foodBolusSize) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
094     * <tr><td>13</td><td><code>toFloat(foodBolusSize) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
095     * <tr><td>14</td><td><code>toFloat(foodBolusSize) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
096     * <tr><td>15</td><td><code>toFloat(foodBolusSize) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
097     * <tr><td>16</td><td><code>toFloat(correctionBolusSize) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
098     * <tr><td>17</td><td><code>toFloat(correctionBolusSize) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
099     * <tr><td>18</td><td><code>toFloat(correctionBolusSize) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
100     * <tr><td>19</td><td><code>toFloat(correctionBolusSize) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
101     * <tr><td>20</td><td><code>toFloat(totalBolusSize) [byte 0]</code></td></tr>
102     * <tr><td>21</td><td><code>toFloat(totalBolusSize) [byte 1]</code></td></tr>
103     * <tr><td>22</td><td><code>toFloat(totalBolusSize) [byte 2]</code></td></tr>
104     * <tr><td>23</td><td><code>toFloat(totalBolusSize) [byte 3]</code></td></tr>
105     * </table>
106     */
107    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, int bolusId, int spare, float foodBolusSize, float correctionBolusSize, float totalBolusSize, int headerHighNibble) {
108        return Bytes.combine(
109            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(66, headerHighNibble),
110            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
111            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
112            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(bolusId), 
113            Bytes.firstTwoBytesLittleEndian(spare), 
114            Bytes.toFloat(foodBolusSize), 
115            Bytes.toFloat(correctionBolusSize), 
116            Bytes.toFloat(totalBolusSize));
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * @return bolus ID
121     */
122    public int getBolusId() {
123        return bolusId;
124    }
125    /**
126     * @return the raw 16-bit word at offset 2. The low byte is the queued flag, see {@link #isQueued()}.
127     */
128    public int getSpare() {
129        return spare;
130    }
131
132    /**
133     * @return true if the bolus was queued (Tandem Source schema field "Queued", byte 2)
134     */
135    public boolean isQueued() {
136        return queued;
137    }
138
139    /**
140     * @return the portion of the bolus amount relating to food from carbs
141     */
142    public float getFoodBolusSize() {
143        return foodBolusSize;
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * @return the portion of the bolus amount relating to the correction bolus from BG+IOB
148     */
149    public float getCorrectionBolusSize() {
150        return correctionBolusSize;
151    }
152
153    /**
154     * @return the total bolus amount which is scheduled to be delivered following this message.
155     * note that this may not be correctionBolusSize+foodBolusSize if the amounts are overridden,
156     * or due to ieee float arithmetic
157     *
158     * <p>Where the amounts are not overridden the identity holds, but the pump recomputes the
159     * total in float, so a small number of records differ from the sum by one unit in the last
160     * place. Compare with a tolerance of {@link HistoryLog#INSULIN_FLOAT_EPSILON} rather than
161     * exact float equality, and do not use exact equality on these values as a reconciliation or
162     * deduplication key.
163     */
164    public float getTotalBolusSize() {
165        return totalBolusSize;
166    }
167}
